items.title: Saboteur
items.text: Saboteur: As an action, discard a City card to remove a Hollow Men figure from a city matching the color of the card.

mechanics.effect: Discard a City card to remove a Hollow Men figure from a city matching the color of the card.
restrictions: The city must match the color of the discarded City card

items.title: Rehab Nurse
items.text: Rehab Nurse: As an action, discard 2 Player cards to take 1 City card of your choice from Package 6 and add it to your hand.

mechanics.effect: Discard 2 Player cards to take 1 City card of your choice from Package 6 and add it to your hand.
restrictions: The City card comes from Package 6

items.title: Misinformation Specialist
items.text: Misinformation Specialist: As an action, move a Hollow Men figure from your city to an adjacent city containing 2 or fewer Hollow Men figures.

mechanics.effect: Move a Hollow Men figure from your city to an adjacent city containing 2 or fewer Hollow Men figures.
restrictions: The figure starts in your city
The destination contains 2 or fewer Hollow Men figures

items.title: CHARACTER ABILITIES
items.text:
CHARACTER ABILITIES
Add these to your pool of character abilities.

Misinformation Specialist: As an action, move a Hollow Men figure from your city to an adjacent city containing 2 or fewer Hollow Men figures. (2)

Saboteur: As an action, discard a City card to remove a Hollow Men figure from a city matching the color of the card. (2)

Rehab Nurse: As an action, discard 2 Player cards to take 1 City card of your choice from Package 6 and add it to your hand. (1)

mechanics.effect: Add these stickers to the pool of character abilities.

summary: Three character abilities and the pool card that prices them. Misinformation Specialist 2, Saboteur 2, Rehab Nurse 1. The orange cost circles are on the pool card, not on the stickers. Corner badge on the pool card is 28.
